description: This file defines a feature for deleting comments within an ASP.NET Core project, including command validation and the request handler logic for removing a comment based on a slug and comment ID.

classes.name: Delete.Command
classes.description: A request command that encapsulates the data needed to delete a comment, including the article slug and comment ID.

classes.name: Delete.CommandValidator
classes.description: Validates the command data, ensuring the Slug is not null or empty.

classes.name: Delete.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the delete comment request by locating the article and comment, then removing the comment from the database.

methods.name: <constructor>
methods.description: Constructs the CommandValidator; sets validation rules.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Executes the logic to delete a comment based on the provided command.
